sources.entry: Frpc-Desktop - Open-source desktop client for FRP reverse proxy and intranet penetration with a visual interface. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A cross-platform desktop client for the FRP reverse proxy that provides a visual interface for configuring frpc and exposing local services through intranet penetration.
summary.what_it_does: Frpc-Desktop is a desktop app for managing frpc (FRP client) configurations without editing files by hand. According to the README, it supports all frp versions, visual proxy configuration, and auto-start on boot. It can support multiple users via user and meta_token, and it supports TCP, UDP, STCP, XTCP, and HTTP-related proxy types, plus proxy protocol. It can import and export configurations, recognize an existing frpc.toml, and add proxies in batches for TCP and UDP ports. The README also mentions download of frp versions through mirror sites, quick sharing of frps, a portable build, and multiple languages including English. Version 2.0 is built on Tauri and upgrades the earlier Electron 1.x app in place.
use_cases: expose a local web service to the internet through frp
manage multiple frpc proxies with a GUI
intranet penetration for remote access to home or office machines
import an existing frpc.toml into a visual editor
back up and restore frp client configurations
notable: Visual configuration of frpc proxies, with import of existing frpc.toml files
Auto-start on boot and a portable version
Batch port creation for TCP and UDP proxies
Download of frp versions through mirror sites
Built on Tauri; in-place upgrade path from the 1.x Electron app with NeDB data import
caveats: Building from source needs Node.js 22.12+ and a stable Rust toolchain with Tauri prerequisites
On macOS, the app may be reported as damaged; the README gives a workaround command (sudo xattr -cr Frpc-Desktop.app)
Upgrading from 1.x imports older NeDB data on first launch; original files are kept as *.bak
